_provenance.what: GET /api/admin/ranking-judgments/candidates?limit=40 — the LIVE labeling sampler output, captured BEFORE the #2019 fix.
_provenance.the_defect: 21 of 40 rows returned rendered_probability=null, ranks 1/2/3 among them — the three blank cards Alex hit. Every one had field_sum > 2.0, the band the served feed renders RAW.
_provenance.outcomes_note: The pre-fix endpoint emitted top_outcomes:null on every card it withheld, so the captured payload could not carry the very probabilities the defect is about. `outcomes` is therefore read separately from futures_outcomes for all 40 markets (941 rows) — the real inputs the sampler held when it returned the blanks.
_provenance.price_age_note: price_age_days_at_capture = days since max(futures_outcomes.last_updated). market.updated_at is a BULK-WRITE timestamp (identical to the microsecond across unrelated markets) and says ~5h on rows whose prices last moved in May, so it is not a freshness signal.
